title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Annual Aggregate, Claim Count and Deductible Application Terms
content:
Each coverage level of the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan limits how many claims the plan pays, and how much in total, for losses whose loss dates fall in any rolling 365-day window, and fixes how the deductible applies.

## Terms by level

| Coverage level | Claims paid per rolling 365-day window (most) | Annual aggregate (multiple of the coverage limit) | Deductible once per loss occurrence | Two units, two claims and two deductibles |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | 2 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | 2 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | 2 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | 2 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | 3 | 1.5 | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | 3 | 1.5 | Yes | Yes |

## Clause notes

1. **Claim count.** The plan pays at most 2 claims with loss dates in any rolling 365-day window on the $2,000, $3,000, $5,000 and $7,500 Plans, and at most 3 on the $10,000 and $15,000 Plans.
2. **Annual aggregate.** The total paid on claims with loss dates in any rolling 365-day window is limited to a multiple of the level's coverage limit: 1 times the limit on the $2,000 to $7,500 Plans, and 1.5 times the limit on the $10,000 and $15,000 Plans.
3. **Deductible per occurrence.** At every level the deductible applies once per loss occurrence.
4. **Separate units.** At every level a loss that affects two rented units is settled as two claims, each with its own deductible.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical plan whose coverage limit is 6,400.00 and whose aggregate multiple is 1.5 would have an annual aggregate of 9,600.00; with a multiple of 1 it would be 6,400.00.
